RUN |4 NGINX_VERSION=1.30.6 MIN_NGINX_VERSION=1.30.6 NGINX_PROXY_VERSION=1.11.6 DOCKER_GEN_VERSION=0.17.2 /bin/sh -c set -eu;     apt-get update -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any;     DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get upgrade -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold;     rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit

RUN |4 NGINX_VERSION=1.30.6 MIN_NGINX_VERSION=1.30.6 NGINX_PROXY_VERSION=1.11.6 DOCKER_GEN_VERSION=0.17.2 /bin/sh -c set -eu;     test -n "${NGINX_VERSION}" && test -n "${MIN_NGINX_VERSION}";     actual="$(nginx -v 2>&1 | sed -n 's|^nginx version: nginx/||p')";     echo "nginx ${actual} expected=${NGINX_VERSION} required>=${MIN_NGINX_VERSION}";     [ "${actual}" = "${NGINX_VERSION}" ] || { echo "nginx is ${actual}, not ${NGINX_VERSION}" >&2; exit 1; };     lowest="$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "${actual}" "${MIN_NGINX_VERSION}" | sort -t. -k1,1n -k2,2n -k3,3n | head -1)";     if [ "${lowest}" != "${MIN_NGINX_VERSION}" ]; then         echo "nginx ${actual} is older than ${MIN_NGINX_VERSION}: refusing to build a vulnerable image" >&2;         exit 1;     fi # buildkit

RUN |4 NGINX_VERSION=1.30.6 MIN_NGINX_VERSION=1.30.6 NGINX_PROXY_VERSION=1.11.6 DOCKER_GEN_VERSION=0.17.2 /bin/sh -c echo "\ninclude /etc/nginx/toplevel.conf.d/*.conf;" >> /etc/nginx/nginx.conf    && sed -i 's/worker_connections.*;$/worker_connections  10240;/' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf    && sed -i -e '/^\}$/{s//\}\nworker_rlimit_nofile 20480;/;:a' -e '$!N;$!ba' -e '}' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf    && mkdir -p '/etc/nginx/toplevel.conf.d'    && mkdir -p '/etc/nginx/dhparam'    && mkdir -p '/etc/nginx/certs'    && mkdir -p '/usr/share/nginx/html/errors' # buildkit
